build: Male edition first name prompt, with separately published male/female gameplay overlays

extra: Initialized rows of the supplied physical image

comments.text: Load-address entry of the male gameplay object. The MAP1 absolute-load object header names load address $8466, and the object's first three bytes are 4C 92 b3, i.e. JMP $B392. Execution of the gameplay occupant begins here and transfers immediately to the setjmp routine. Inputs: The gameplay object has been loaded at $8466 by the MAP1 preamble. Outputs: Control transferred to $B392. Assumptions: valid only while the male gameplay object is the live occupant of $8466-$9991. The three bytes are typed as code and labelled here because this is the only entry into the occupant; $B392 itself lies outside the overlay, in ordinary RAM shared with the questionnaire phase, so the jump is only meaningful once this overlay is loaded. Clobbers: None at this instruction. Hardware: None.

Male gameplay occupant. Run the gameplay phase and Life Map interface. Inputs: current stage/save state, loaded resident engine, and canonical MAP media. Outputs: long-lived main loop; no normal VM return is reachable. It loads stage configuration, converts initial_cursor_cell_index to row/column, renders and scrolls the map, moves sprite 0, dispatches selected cells, and enters resume/save/status paths. Assumptions: stage 1-7 and validated MAP directories. Clobbers/state: map cursor, stream state, display work, and progression fields. Hardware: VIC-II sprites/bitmap and CIA input through resident helpers. VM entry $84DC, frame -16, bytecode $84E1-$87C3 (365 decoded operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Dispatch one Life Map cell action. Inputs: +8/+10 identify the cell/slot and packed selector metadata from $81C5. Outputs: status/menu result or the result of run_life_map_turn. Selector 0 is inert, 1 opens LIFE TIME, 5 opens life status, and other validated category selectors are unpacked into side, slot, and action arguments for $8A85. Assumptions: selector low nybble is 0-11. Clobbers: VM expression stack and UI work. Hardware: display/input through callees. VM entry $87C5, frame -4, bytecode $87CA-$881A (38 operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Open and position the MAP record stream for the current life stage. Inputs: +8 controls initial/retry behavior; $82BD supplies stage. Outputs: active stream identifier at $CADB and positioned framed-record state, or an error result after the retry prompt. Stage 7 selects MAP27's second section; other stages select their matching MAP source. Assumptions: canonical REL framing. Clobbers: stream/file and temporary filename state. Hardware: IEC/CIA 2 through prepare_map_record_stream. VM entry $881B, frame -37, bytecode $8820-$88A8 (63 operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Load and validate the current MAP stage section. Inputs: current stage $82BD and optional fresh-load flag +8. Outputs: age bounds at $803B-$803E, transient stage words at $803F-$8042, persisted 48-byte configuration at $81C5, route count/words at $82BB/$81F7, initial cursor $82DB, terminal scene ID $82F5, and block-span stream offset $82F7. It clamps age to the stage minimum and reports malformed lengths. Clobbers: a 514-byte VM frame and MAP stream cursor. Hardware: IEC through stream readers. VM entry $88A9, frame -514, bytecode $88AE-$89DB (137 operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Invalidate the active MAP record stream. Inputs: $CADB active-stream identifier. Outputs: expected record ID invalidated through $5F27 and $CADB cleared to zero; no action when already zero. Clobbers: VM primary and stream state. Hardware: none directly. VM entry $8A72, frame 0, bytecode $8A77-$8A84 (6 operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Execute one Life Map turn. Inputs: selected row/column/category and mode in VM arguments, current route/config arrays, state vector, and active MAP stream. Outputs: selected episode executed or terminal/stage result returned. It hit-tests the map, selects a remaining category episode, executes descriptor chains, removes finite choices, advances age by compressed-span allocation, handles terminal cells, and redraws transitions. Assumptions: validated route words and nonempty eligible masks. Clobbers: progression, mask, cursor, descriptor, and UI work state. Hardware: VIC-II, CIA input, and SID-backed randomness through callees. VM entry $8A85, frame -5, bytecode $8A8A-$8CA4 (274 operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Finish a life stage and apply its financial transition. Inputs: current stage, cash/debt limbs, reverse_stage_index_8_minus_stage, and post-stage menu state. Outputs: next stage selected (wrapping after 7), acquisitions reset at wrap, a stage-scaled debt payment transferred from cash, debt low limb cleared, and the stage stored in the sign convention expected by the next loader. Menu results dispatch save, resume, continue, or exit paths. Assumptions: base-1000 money limbs and nonzero stage divisor. Clobbers: stage, acquisitions, cash/debt, UI and stream state. Hardware: display/input through callees. VM entry $8CFF, frame -4, bytecode $8D04-$8DCF (96 operations).

Male gameplay occupant. Inline-native gateway for episode selection. JSR $7059 consumes both hardware returns; header bytes encode saved workspace count 0 and VM-stack adjustment -16. Execution begins at $8DD6. There is no encoded target pointer and no fallthrough into the header. Assumptions: Valid only while this overlay is the live occupant of $8466-$CC69; the RAM-resident gateway at $7059 must be present and reached by JSR, with two return addresses on the stack. The two header bytes after the JSR must stay typed as data -- $7059 reads them as {saved-workspace count 0, signed stack adjustment -16} and takes the body as return+4, i.e. $8DD6 -- so nothing may be inserted and there is no fallthrough into the header. Hardware: Touches no hardware: a single JSR into the RAM-resident runtime descriptor gateway at $7059. Inputs: none consumed here — the body reads no register or memory location before handing control to RAM:runtime_descriptor_call_gateway, whose inputs apply unchanged. Outputs: none of its own; RAM:runtime_descriptor_call_gateway consumes the pushed return address and continues at the body that follows the two header bytes, so the observable outputs are those of the routine it introduces. Clobbers: nothing of its own — control leaves at once, so only the callee's clobbers apply.

Male gameplay occupant. Select an eligible episode from one stage slot. Inputs: native frame identifies the slot/config record; $81D5-$81F4 holds remaining masks and selector metadata is at $81C5. Outputs: one eligible bit/episode index. Ordinary categories clear the selected slot bit. Selector 6 excludes bits already in $7FC0-$7FC3 and adds the chosen family bit there. Assumptions: at least one eligible bit. Clobbers: A,X,Y, zero-page/native arithmetic and mask work. Hardware: SID-backed randomness through the resident random helper. Reachable code $8DD6-$8F8D and $90A0-$9121; intervening and trailing bytes through $91CC are compiler tables/data.

Male gameplay occupant. Advance age and finances from a selected scene's allocated compressed span. Inputs: 16-bit span argument, age scale $803F/$8040, stage state, thoughtfulness, salary state word 37, and cash/debt resources. Age output: delta=(span*scale+512)>>10 is added to fractional year $7FC4/$7FC5; overflow advances player age $7F74 and child age $7F8C. Financial output for a salaried character: expense_percent=floor((100-thoughtfulness)/2)+5*(life_stage-2), then cash_delta=round(salary_thousands*elapsed_years*(100-expense_percent)*10); zero salary follows the later-stage resource-loss branch. Side-choice callers divide span by three before entry. Assumptions: stage configuration and state vector are loaded. Clobbers: A, X, Y and native multiword arithmetic workspace. Hardware: none. Physical extent $91D3-$9829.

Male gameplay occupant. Inline-native gateway for scene-span lookup. JSR $7059 consumes both hardware returns; header bytes encode four saved zero-page workspace bytes and VM-stack adjustment -30. Execution begins at $9830. There is no encoded target pointer and no fallthrough into the header. Assumptions: Valid only while this overlay is the live occupant of $8466-$CC69; the RAM-resident gateway at $7059 must be present and reached by JSR, with two return addresses on the stack. The two header bytes after the JSR must stay typed as data -- $7059 reads them as {saved-workspace count 4, signed stack adjustment -30} and takes the body as return+4, i.e. $9830 -- so nothing may be inserted and there is no fallthrough into the header. Hardware: Touches no hardware: a single JSR into the RAM-resident runtime descriptor gateway at $7059. Inputs: none consumed here — the body reads no register or memory location before handing control to RAM:runtime_descriptor_call_gateway, whose inputs apply unchanged. Outputs: none of its own; RAM:runtime_descriptor_call_gateway consumes the pushed return address and continues at the body that follows the two header bytes, so the observable outputs are those of the routine it introduces. Clobbers: nothing of its own — control leaves at once, so only the callee's clobbers apply.

Male gameplay occupant. Return the allocated compressed block span for a scene ID. Inputs: scene ID argument, stage terminal/count metadata, and four-byte block-span-table payload offset $82F7. Outputs: zero for scene zero, the exact directory allocation span for a valid scene, or failure for malformed/exhausted stream state. It walks little-endian spans, accumulates the 32-bit payload cursor, and calls VM $9908 to refill the span window. Assumptions: Entered through the $982A shim, which preserves four workspace bytes, so the $7059 frame must be live with $06/$07 valid and X=0 on entry -- X supplies both the zero result and the zero comparison operand. Frame +9/+10 must hold the scene ID, with 0 and $00FF treated as terminators; the four-byte payload offset at $82F7-$82FA must be current, $30-$33 must be the reserved workspace, and $CC65-$CC68 must be free stream scratch. This overlay must be the active occupant of $8466-$CC69. Clobbers: A,X,Y, zero-page $30-$33 and $CC65-$CC68 stream work. Hardware: IEC only through the refill helper. Physical extent $9830-$9907.

Male gameplay occupant. Refill the scene-span stream with retry handling. Called by native span lookup when its local span window is exhausted. Inputs: 32-bit MAP payload cursor at $CC65-$CC68, current stage/stream state, and work buffers. Outputs: validates/reads the next span window, advances the logical cursor through tell_map_payload_offset, resets dependent decoder state, and returns zero on success; media/record errors are reported and retried after stream invalidation. Clobbers: $CAxx stream/decode work and VM temporaries. Hardware: IEC/CIA 2 through MAP stream helpers. VM entry $9908, frame 0, bytecode $990D-$99BB (71 operations); the byte-identical tail $9992-$99BB remains in ordinary RAM.
